integrity: The infinite statements are proved from the Beatty membership criterion, an explicit circle-interval calculation, and a reconstructed discrepancy argument using Fibonacci convergent blocks. Finite computation is used only as a normalization and regression check, not as evidence for the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives an explicit first-order phase profile with O(log n) error, not an exact closed formula or an optimized discrepancy constant. It does not extract finer lower-order information from the known Fibonacci linear representation of the sequence.
title: A rotation profile and limiting law for lower-plus-upper Wythoff representations
